instruction: Look at full_gui_benchmark.step. Create a complete FreeCAD Path/CAM Job. Complete Face machining of the top, two pockets, eight holes, outside Profile, and top-face Engrave. The toolpaths must keep at least 3 mm clearance from the two fixture blocks. Tool definitions: use T1, T2, T3, and T4 tool controllers covering end mills, drills, and an engraving cutter sufficient for facing, pockets, holes, outside profile, and top-face engraving. Use the Job, stock/setup, origin, ToolBit/ToolController, operation, toolpath verification, and Path postprocessor dialogs as needed. Post the required G-code/NC output file(s) to the output folder using exactly these absolute file paths: /home/user/Desktop/task-20.nc.
